newsitem.title: CHINA: Bad weather hits south China rice, rape crops.
newsitem.headline: Bad weather hits south China rice, rape crops.

text.p: Unseasonable cool and wet weather has hit the growth of early rice and rape crops in China's southern regions, the Futures Herald said on Friday.
Low temperatures and heavy rains since late March had affected early rice sowing and stunted the growth of rice seedlings, the newspaper quoted Chinese meteorologists as saying.
The bad weather had also affected the growth of rape crops, the newspaper said.
The cool and wet trend was expected to persist through early April and a late frost could strike crops, it warned but gave no further details.
China produced 9.1 million tonnes of rapeseed in 1996, down 6.0 percent from the previous year, Zhang Sai, director of the State Statistical Bureau, said on Friday.
